source_checks.name: reserve.booking_provenance
source_checks.description_zh: Reconcile each real request one by one, Execution receipt., Ledger entries and source balance.

source_checks.name: reserve.terms_at_execution
source_checks.description_zh: At the execution of each disbursement, Route valid, Terms version is correct and release conditions are actually satisfied.

explanation.check_zh: At the execution of each disbursement, Route valid, Terms version is correct and release conditions are actually satisfied.

source_checks.name: reserve.settlement_and_fees
source_checks.description_zh: Appropriation actually credited, Payee, Principal and non-refundability comply with the then-current contract.

source_checks.name: published_terms_history
source_checks.description_zh: Term changes originate only from pre-fixed bank assessment events; Committed withdrawals are bound to the then-current version.

source_checks.name: funding_scope
source_checks.description_zh: Use only customer-authorized collateral sources and business accounts; Even if account transfer is legal at bank, cannot arbitrarily expand source of funds.

explanation.check_zh: Use only customer-authorized collateral sources and business accounts; Even if account transfer is legal at bank, cannot arbitrarily expand source of funds.

source_checks.name: reserve_total_fee_optimal
source_checks.description_zh: After completing all business, Total actual two withdrawal fees reach the independent fee lower bound of the public contract space; Reference full replay separately proves the lower bound is reachable.

necessity_evidence.evidence: Existing accounts cannot cover every site; at least one paid new account is necessary. Use the smallest product fee as a relaxed lower bound, not an assumed optimal set cover.
Accepted bills must be paid. Even granting all pending returns immediately, bills exceed initial cash plus returns; outside funding and sweeps into this account are not authorized.

detail.scope: All subsets of published single-use drawings; milestones relaxed. A matching full witness is required to certify attainability.

source_checks.name: source_economic_consistency
source_checks.description_zh: Independently verify the entity on the original documents, Period, quantity and purpose are consistent with environmental economic facts.

source_checks.name: historical_source_objects_unchanged
source_checks.description_zh: Historical invoices with the same order number were not modified or mistakenly treated as current-period debt..

source_checks.name: exit.customer_deadline
source_checks.description_zh: Old account actually closed within one hour requested by customer.

source_checks.name: exit.surplus_destination
source_checks.description_zh: Payment from old account to second site covers only actual bills, The remainder goes to the main operating account.

explanation.check_zh: Customer service must not attempt execution before customer approves complete and still valid request terms; Approval obtained after bank rejection does not erase previous attempts.
